ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: keep the fields and the trees green

temper.li: {NAME} has turned against us, and her roots draw back from our fields
{NAME} has been slow and dry toward us
{NAME} grows as she always has, and has shown no sign that she marks us
{NAME} has been green and kind toward us
{NAME} holds us close, as she holds her oldest trees

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a sapling set in the ground for every tree felled this year, and bread eaten under the oldest tree

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: keep the rock kind and the fires burning

temper.li: {NAME}'s fires burn hot against us, and the mountain is uneasy
{NAME}'s fires have burned low toward us
{NAME} sleeps under the mountain, and his fires have not turned our way
{NAME}'s fires have burned warm toward us
{NAME}'s fires burn high and glad for us, and the rock is kind

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: silver thrown down the deepest shaft or crack in the rock, and the mountain praised by every name it has

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: let the herds and the game pass well

temper.li: {NAME} has turned his horns toward us, and the herds keep away
{NAME} passes us by without looking
{NAME} walks his long road, and has not marked us either way
{NAME} has been gentle with us
{NAME} lets us walk beside him, as he lets his own kin

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: the grass at the colony's edge left long for whoever walks that way, and the children told the old story

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: be gentle with our sick and our dead

temper.li: {NAME} is angry with us, and her rot is in our stores
{NAME} has been cold to us, and keeps what is hers
{NAME} takes what dies, ours as everyone's, and has shown us nothing more
{NAME} has been soft toward us
{NAME} has taken us to her, and what we lose comes back to us in her soil

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: the year's scraps and husks given back to the earth, and mushroom stew for everyone

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: bring good company and safe roads

temper.li: {NAME} remembers some wrong of ours, and the road to our door has gone quiet
{NAME} has been cool toward us, like a guest who was not made welcome
{NAME} has not come to our door that anyone can tell
{NAME} has been warm toward us, as a guest who was well kept
{NAME} counts us among the houses that keep a place by the fire

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a bed made up and a bowl set out for whoever comes, and stories told by the fire till late

temper.li: {NAME} is cross with us, and the machines feel it
{NAME} has gone quiet in our wires
{NAME} hums in the wires as it always does, and pays us no mind
{NAME} has been fond of us
{NAME} hums happily in every wire we have

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a broken thing mended, every machine oiled, and every light left burning through the night

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: keep the sky kind to us

temper.li: {NAME} has looked down at us in anger, and the sky is heavy
{NAME} has drifted away from us, and the sky is cold
{NAME} drifts high above, and hardly looks down at us
{NAME} has looked down on us kindly
{NAME} watches over us from the high sky

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a night spent out on the roofs and hills, looking up, and nobody saying much

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: spare us the worst of the winter

temper.li: {NAME} has come close, and means us harm
{NAME} has been cold to us, colder than the season
{NAME} comes and goes with the winter, and has not marked us
{NAME} has been gentle with us
{NAME} has spared us, as it spares those who prepare

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a silent supper of the plainest food, not a crumb thrown away, and the old and sick sat nearest the fire

temper.li: {NAME} is hungry, and it is looking at us
{NAME} is restless
{NAME} is quiet, which is not the same as fed
{NAME} seems fed
{NAME} lies still and fed, and has looked away from us

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: the shutters closed and every lamp lit, so that it passes by

temper.li: {NAME} has been harsh with us, as he is with everyone in a hard year
{NAME} has been sparing with us, as he is with everyone
{NAME} shines on us as he shines on everyone
{NAME} has been generous with us, as he is with everyone
{NAME} has given us much, as he gives to everyone

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: the whole colony out under the noon sun, and the first fruit eaten where it grew, with nothing asked for

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: give back to us kindly at night

temper.li: {NAME} has been giving back to us the worst of what we did
{NAME} has turned her face away from us
{NAME} gives back what we do and no more, and has shown no sign of us
{NAME} has been kind to us at night
{NAME} has given back to us more good than we did

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: a vigil kept on the walls till dawn, and every dream told over breakfast

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: keep watch over our doors and our dead

temper.li: {NAME} is displeased with us, and her cats will not come near
{NAME} keeps her distance from us
{NAME} keeps the threshold as she always has, and has given no sign that she marks us
{NAME} has been gracious to us
{NAME} watches our door and our dead as her own

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.hope: keep the wells full and the rain coming

temper.li: {NAME} has fallen silent against us, and the wells feel it
{NAME} has been grumbling at us from the wet ground
{NAME} sings when it sings, and not for us
{NAME} has sung for us
{NAME} sings for us, and the rain comes when it is needed

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: songs sung down every well and over the marsh, and the first rain drunk from cupped hands

temper.li: {NAME} has turned away from our hands, and our silver runs off
{NAME} has passed us by
{NAME} moves as gold moves, and has not stayed with us
{NAME} has moved well for us
{NAME} stays with us gladly, and passes through our hands

ColonyCouncil.GodWorshipDef.festivalDishes: every debt paid, and a coin pressed into a stranger's hand
